svg.title: Survival waves per bot per map
svg.desc: Strip chart: one row per map, one dot per seeded run, a tick at the median, for the novice, solid, eco and solid-with-Commander bots on Pilot. Shaded bands mark the novice and solid targets; the dashed line is the wave 160 ceiling.
svg.text: Wave reached by each bot on each map (Pilot)
hollow dot: the run ended on a Storm Titan leak; tick: median
